_comment: Synthetic OWASP ZAP baseline report against http://127.0.0.1:3000. The host stands in for a local Juice Shop-style lab app. No third-party target.

alerts.desc: The lab application reflected SQL syntax errors for a search parameter. Use parameterized queries.
alerts.solution: Use parameterized queries and reject unexpected input on the server.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: The lab application did not send a Content-Security-Policy response header.
alerts.solution: Send a Content-Security-Policy header that matches the application's own origins.
